pr_title: Add code block highlight to orgmode back
pr_body:
Partially fix  #14219. After #12047 merged, all code block highlight from frontend to backend. All markdown files has been handled well but orgmode and third-party renderer lost code block highlight .

This PR takes orgmode code block highlight back.

issue_context.title: Plantuml highlighting doesn't work anymore
issue_context.body:
I updated recently to 1.13.1. I am not sure if either the issue existed already in 1.13.0 as I discovered it by coincidence with 1.13.1. But I am pretty sure with 1.12.6 everything was working.

My gitea uses an external plantuml server to render plantuml code blocks within markdown files. Now it doesn't anymore. I have seen that the names of the html classes with the rendered plantuml code was changed from "language-plantuml" to "chroma language plantuml". I changed this in the javascript (example from gitea customize page). Even I escaped it. It doesn't work. But I detected in the javascript console in the safari that the custom javascript is not called anymore. Could it be that with the changing to server side highlighting this feature was removed? I have seen in the discourse a similar issue with ASCIDOC. 

Otherwise I am open to any other proposals. Or I have to switch back to 1.12.6. 
thx
comments: I have a feeling that this would be easier to solve on #configuration on Discord following which we could update the webpage
I don't understand this feeling. Is it a bug? or must the configuration be adapted?

It's very likely a configuration issue. One which will require live debugging. 

Once it's fixed we can come back here and suggest updates to the docs as necessary.

why are you assuming that it is an configuration issue? I mean it was working. And it was working very well. Or do you mean the configuration be updated due to the new feature of the server-side highlighting? 
I mean it seems for me that the rendering isn't called anymore due to the enabling of the mermaid -stuff. Which is BTW working like hell for me. Seems like the client-side highlighting was disabled at all. OK I will check the PR for that. But I won't spend much effort. Otherwise I will go back to 1.12.6
Just come to discord - it'll be easier to work this out there
Maybe related with #12047 ?

thnx that was the merge I was looking for. And now I remember I skipped 1.13.0 as I never trust a zeroed version. And I remember that a friend of mine mentioned something like the plantuml is suddenly not working anymore.

Ok somewhere here https://github.com/ydelafollye/gitea/commit/845b9f1dc48c71bbcf4891267dc973066bf04d55 it should be happened. the change to chroma IMO seems fine. For me it is weird that the footer.tmpl won't be added anyhow. So the js-function to establish the communication with the external plantuml server won't work - even if I added the "chroma " to the call. 
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/9553 is open anyway
I will roll back to 1.12.6 as my plantuml sketches are not rendered anymore :(
dude seriously I asked you to come to discord so we could work out how to fix this.

Yeah we could do this - Otherwise it seems I will be doomed. 
But I roll back anyhow. BTW I already did it. And for what do you need me? IMO you should add some plantuml example in a markdown file and let it render in a test gitea. You may debug it.
OK roll back doesn't seem to be the best way as `Downgrading database version from '156' to '141' is not supported and may result in loss of data integrity.` :(
You have to change the version on database manually.
Yes I have read ist too thx. But I saw that the issue may be fixed. So I will wart for a while

@Sepphod can you provide some files to test agains?

just create a repo on https://try.gitea.io/
check https://try.gitea.io/sepphod/plantumltest/src/branch/master/README.md => seems not working for me. but maybe I did something wrong

@Sepphod it works if you use `cmd` or something supported ...

-> https://try.gitea.io/6543/plantumltest/src/branch/master/README.md
@Sepphod upstream issue: https://github.com/alecthomas/chroma/issues/443
sorry I don't understand your comment. I used it the same way it was working before. If this won't work I have to rework several markdown files in my repos.
@Sepphod we migrated to a new syntax-highlighter (chroma) witch do not support PlantUML yet ... so I created an issue on there project ...
yeah I created the ticket for ;) but I wrongly assumed it is already fixed. But you just wanted some test files - my mistake ;)

Unless I misunderstand the goal here, this is out of scope for Chroma. What @Sepphod is asking for is for a PlantUML _renderer_ that will take PlantUML blocks and render UML in their place. Even if Chroma adds support for it it won't do this.

It sounds like Gitea used to support custom block renderers through some plugin system, but no longer does. That regression is unrelated to Chroma.

OK - with Gitea < 1.13.1 it was possible to do client-side rendering. the MD parser detected the keyword "plantuml" and created a HTML class with the type of plantuml. an embedded java script was called which transmit all plantuml data to a given plantuml server - which renders an image and send it back... that's all

Yes looks like I mussunderstood it ... :/

I know we have [mermaid-js](https://mermaid-js.github.io/mermaid/) integration (since 1.13.0  #12334)

EDIT: sorry if we brocke your custom JS thin :/ - it should be doable somehow throu I wont have time to look into it ...
So you have three options:
1. stay at 1.12.x (not a good idear considdering sec-issues)
2. migrate to mermaid js ( need time and effort to convert stuff :/ )
3. find the issue holding your JS back from executing ( also will consume some time)

I Dont know if i like your proposal. Everything was working before. Why this decision with that mermaid stuff?
plantuml is widely used...
and there was a PR  some weeks ago: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/14222 what will happen with that one?
@Sepphod #14222 doesn't finished there are some bugs. I think I will continue that work.

Sorry peeps - I think I've finally worked this out.

You should change the languages that you're looking for.

`` ```cmd ``  will be detected and rendered as cmd language so - what I would recommend is that you use `` ```plantuml-cmd `` instead and change your code to make that work.

An alternative fix would be for us to include the raw unrendered text within a hidden `<pre><code>` element.

review_comments: Most of this is duplicating with `modules/markup/markdown/markdown.go`, can we extract it to a shared function like `RenderCodePre`?

I think they are similar but different functions. `markdown`'s will be invoked twice, once before rendering the code, another after rendering the code. But orgmode is only one function.
Is it really valuable to merge the two functions since Gitea only supports the two formats.
I think this looks sufficiently different from the code in `markdown.go`
